# Test inputs

The header fixtures and text tables contain filtered game definitions: costs, effect descriptions, graph nodes and expected supported/refused research rows. They contain no player profiles, account credentials or Android preferences. Original definition data retains its existing rights; see the repository's third-party notices.

Persistence fixtures are generated by the test executables in disposable directories. The supply test supplies a synthetic receipt to the inventory test, which supplies the modification test. Legacy migration cases write the actual old wire length/checksum and check that reads preserve their source bytes. Catalogue corruption tests create synthetic bounded wire records and never use those files as playable missions.
